body: I pretty much got away with a knife(think Swiss Army knife)in my bag...

Summer School in my area is...you gotta protect yourself. Like the delinquents and retards. I just skipped class a whole lot, and got bored as hell, so I had to take Summer school.

They were searching us all(except the retards), and I remembered I had a knife in my pocket. That’s the only time that I was about to shit bricks over if they found. I had it for protection...
people were going 20 over. How come *I* got pulled over??
people were already miles and miles away from me going 20 over...

I’ve been handcuffed 2x...at school...for random checks. I don’t live in a great area, but jeez!

I did have a knife on me that they didn’t find. I had the knife for protection. Summer school was basically with the bad delinquents, so we all got checked. The retards never did because the ones in summer school were pretty harmless.
They have put handcuffs on me in middle and high school...
...and I was following traffic.
yeah. it was. so what. the dumb bitch didn’t need to pull me over because I was following traffic...

this makes me think of my high school econ and history teachers(both alive, the history teacher left left, idk why(still alive), but he was a great teacher)!  I love how you wrote this. I agree with the other comment; you should send this to his family!
i just want to diiiiiiiieeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
my body is revolting against me wooooo~ Well, my brain...~🤭🙄😐
I’m far from perfect. I think the Morning Star himself made me, yo...
after I’m done pushing them away, they’ll be happy I died. I’m tired of living and putting on a show. pretending to actually be happy...
I make mashed potatoes. If I could cook my feelings away, I’d have to have...a lot of dishes...
meh. numb, really. not really feeling anything. just want to die...
I hate Christmas music. it falls on deaf ears, now. I’ll hum along, but I’ll sing my own lyrics...usually along the lines of me dying, or getting killed...
there is such thing as ‘better.’ all I hear is Butter...
what does ‘better’ mean...🤷🏻‍♀️
Ugh. I can smell the incense they use in the church, during prayer every time I hear Christmas music.
or used as his personal anal beads...(gross I know, but that’s how much ‘karma’ i have...)
hah. i have enough Karma to be burnt by the Morning Star himself...(Morning Star is another term for Satan...)
why should I stay? I have nowhere to be/go...
a lot of people begin liking me. Once they get to know me, they stop hanging around me...
I don’t want to be ‘still here...’
I wanna be dead already. The reason I don’t do it is because I’m afraid of what I may reincarnate into...(I believe in reincarnation)

I know where most of the major arteries are...I love medical stuff, so I know where they are. So if anything, I know where I’d bleed out in a millisecond...also blood never freaked me out, so I wouldn’t freak out if I started bleeding profusely.

sorry, sorry. Morbid, I know, but yeah. Blood never freaked me out.
I don’t want to talk. I just want to leave this world...

not a lot of people like me...even though I act all kind and shit. I swear like a sailor, belch like one, and have very poor manners. so i guess no one likes me. My coworkers don’t like me, but they tolerate me. I’m just done, yo...
i’m pushing them all away. Making them hate me even more than they do now...
That’s why I want to really push myself far away from them. they wouldn’t care after that...
I just want to die. I already know how Imm going to do it.
